parse.title: Designer In-Spire
parse.wikitext:
{{Event Header|Event-Designer.png}} {{E|Designer In-Spire}} is a {{QueryLink|Events|shrine:Yes|shrine Event}} found in [[Act 2]] and [[Act 3]]. It will only appear if the player has at least 75 [[Gold]]. ==Options== {{Frame|Adjustments}} {{TS|negative||Lose 40}} {{asc|15|(50)}} [[Gold]]{{TS|negative||.}} {{TS|positive||One of the following rewards appears.}} * {{TS|positive||[[Upgrade]] a card.}} * {{TS|positive||[[Upgrade]] two random cards.}}
{{Frame|Clean Up}} {{TS|negative||Lose 60}} {{asc|15|(75)}} [[Gold]]{{TS|negative||.}} {{TS|positive||One of the following rewards appears.}} * {{TS|positive||Remove a card.}} * {{TS|positive||[[Transform]] two cards.}}
{{Frame|Full Service}} {{TS|negative||Lose 90}} {{asc|15|(110)}} [[Gold]]{{TS|negative||.}} {{TS|positive||Remove a card, then [[upgrade]] a random card.}}

{{Frame|Punch}} {{TS|negative||Lose 3}} {{asc|15|(5)}} {{TS|negative||HP.}} ==Dialogue==
You discover a {{TS|green|up|colorful}} shop with the banner "IN-SPIRE" and walk in to see what's inside.
"No, no way. Nope. Can't let you in!"
A man with ridiculous clothing appears at the entrance to bar you.


{{Frame|Continue}}

"This will not do, no no. What is this style? {{TS||shake|Disgusting!}} Are you {{TS|negative||bleeeeding?}} {{TS|purple|up|Groooss.}} {{TS||shake|Business??}} You a customer? Fine. {{TS||up|Whaaatever."}}
He lets out an exaggerated sigh and points at a list of services.
The services seem fine, but you would rather punch this smug man in his smug face.


{{Frame|Adjustments}}, {{Frame|Clean Up}}, and {{Frame|Full Service}}
"Okay, bye bye now."
...should've punched him.
{{Frame|Punch}}
You punch him so hard your fist hurts.
"My {{TS||shake|FACE!!}} Now I'll have to-"
He fainted. Who's {{TS|purple|up|groooss}} and {{TS|negative||bleeeeding}} now?
==Trivia== * This event is internally called Designer. * If {{Frame|Punch}} is chosen, the Designer's portrait will change. This is the only [[Events|Event]] that changes its portrait.
[[File:DesignerPunched2.jpg|200px|thumb|The Designer after getting punched.]]
